easy.name: Easy
easy.note: Pitched at the real paper, a little above it in places. Mostly single-step recall with plausible options, plus two-step maths and reasoning. Aim for 66 net and keep going until it is steady.

medium.name: Medium
medium.note: A clear step above the paper. Finer facts, look-alike options, multi-step maths and reasoning, and statement and sequence questions. Same marking, same 66 pass mark.

hard.name: Hard
hard.note: Harder than the real paper, on purpose. Close distractors, fine distinctions, multi-step maths and reasoning, and about one question in four in a statement, NOT or timeline form. Same marking, same 66 pass mark. If you clear these, the real paper should feel kind.
